addons.name: Squeezy Duplicator
addons.description: Deep-duplicate a comp: every precomp inside, at every level, becomes its own copy. Renames, folders and expressions follow.
addons.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="3" width="12" height="12" rx="2.5"/><rect x="9" y="9" width="12" height="12" rx="2.5" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity=".25"/><path d="M15 13v4M13 15h4" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

params.label: Put copies in a new folder

addons.name: Kashida Stretch
addons.description: Arabic text: the kashida stretches out (خولي ← خــــولي) with a light bounce, and can fold back at the end.
addons.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M3 14h4M17 14h4M7 14c2 0 2-4 5-4s3 4 5 4"/></svg>

addons.name: Cylinder Builder
addons.description: Select 2+ layers: they go on a rotating 3D cylinder. The card facing the camera stays sharp; the rest blur, fade and darken by depth as it turns.
addons.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><ellipse cx="12" cy="6" rx="7" ry="2.5"/><path d="M5 6v12c0 1.4 3.1 2.5 7 2.5s7-1.1 7-2.5V6"/></svg>

addons.name: Block Flow
addons.description: Works with one image or many: cards side by side, overlapping, each new image takes its slot through a grid-block glitch while the frame steps down in scale. Select layers in your comp, or images in the Project panel.
addons.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><rect x="3" y="3" width="8" height="8" rx="1.5"/><rect x="13" y="3" width="8" height="8" rx="1.5" opacity=".55"/><rect x="3" y="13" width="8" height="8" rx="1.5" opacity=".55"/><rect x="13" y="13" width="8" height="8" rx="1.5"/></svg>

addons.name: Pixel Scan Reveal
addons.description: Pixel-block wipe reveal with a glowing glass scan strip on the edge: turbulence, mosaic, smear, rainbow and glow. Everything stays editable on a control null.
addons.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><rect x="3" y="3" width="5" height="5" rx="1"/><rect x="10" y="3" width="5" height="5" rx="1" opacity=".6"/><rect x="3" y="10" width="5" height="5" rx="1" opacity=".6"/><rect x="10" y="10" width="5" height="5" rx="1" opacity=".3"/><rect x="17" y="17" width="4" height="4" rx="1" opacity=".3"/></svg>

addons.name: Text Sync
addons.description: Pick an .srt / .vtt file and every caption lands on time, word by word, animated. Select a text layer first to copy its font, size and colour.
addons.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M3 12h2l2-5 3 10 3-8 2 6 2-3h4"/></svg>
